entries.desc: Map the current DONE transition and recovery order so the exact deterministic writes before versus after final evidence checks are explicit.

evidence.note: At commit 42929151 the DONE boundary is mapped: done_prepare performs pre-DONE validation recovery, while version package dist finalization remains outside pre-DONE readiness.

entries.desc: Confirm post-DONE version bump, dist build, and experience cache refresh are not moved into pre-DONE readiness because they intentionally mutate runtime material state after DONE persistence.

evidence.note: Decision docs continue to keep runtime version and finalization writes post-DONE and out of done_prepare.

entries.desc: Reject any broad lifecycle redesign that weakens evidence freshness, autoSyncMain safety, storyFilesHash binding, or material hash blocking semantics.

evidence.note: Build and smoke preserve stale, wrong cwd, wrong branch, stale review, command-backed evidence, and version-bump rejection safety while adding DONE-required recovery.

entries.desc: Evidence-freshness, DONE-required validation, and branch-synced-main blockers show done_prepare as the first recovery command.

evidence.note: Smoke proves evidence-freshness, DONE-required validation, branch-synced-main, and lifecycle_check recovery guidance converge on done_prepare.

entries.desc: DONE-required blocker preserves the original reason text while prefixing the ordered done_prepare recovery path.

evidence.note: done_prepare now invokes the existing done_required_validate path when policy is required and fails closed on failed DONE-required output.

entries.desc: Unrelated blockers such as missing test evidence or verification-intent coverage still point to validate or checklist repair and are not hidden behind done_prepare.

evidence.note: Only ordering-sensitive DONE blockers route to done_prepare; ordinary test evidence and verification-intent coverage still route to validation.

entries.desc: A done-prepare smoke scenario asserts branch-synced-main and done-required-validation blockers route to the same done_prepare command.

entries.desc: The smoke scenario starts with missing DONE-required evidence and verifies the blocker remains visible instead of being silently waived.

evidence.note: Smoke covers failing DONE-required validation and proves done_prepare blocks at validate while writing FAIL evidence for inspection.

entries.desc: The test asserts branch sync guidance does not regress to raw git merge main and does not imply evidence freshness predicates were bypassed.

evidence.note: Regression covers lifecycle_check mapping, avoids raw git merge main recovery guidance, and passes whitespace checks.

entries.desc: Documentation or diagnostic text, if changed, describes done_prepare as a host-neutral Lattice workflow command rather than a Codex- or Claude-specific step.

entries.desc: The docs continue to state or imply that version bump, package sync, dist build, and experience cache refresh are post-DONE effects, not pre-DONE validation material.

evidence.note: Docs preserve the pre-DONE done_prepare versus post-DONE finalization boundary after the implementation change.

entries.desc: No stale guidance recommends manual raw git merge plus separate validate/refresh loops as the preferred DONE recovery path for this class of blocker.

evidence.note: User-facing DONE recovery no longer relies on raw git merge plus separate stale refresh loops for the ordering-sensitive blockers.
